what: Remakes check sheet / clips before animatic 3 (11 Nov, code at 98cc08d; Sam's clip and still notes 68-77 were on this version; notes table in notes/remakes.md). Key = Sam's notes a fresh eye could spot on a still. Left out: taste and staging wishes (71 zoom, 49, 67 off-screen gunman), motion and sound (66, 69, 77's wipe entrance), and animatic 1's notes (a different version).

panels.is: a forest: Kaepora Gaebora (a big brown owl, here a hype-man game guide) on a branch, wings flung wide: 'Hello, Link! Are you ready for an adventure?'; the back of Link's capped head bottom left
high angle from the owl's eyes: Link (green cap and tunic, small boy) unsure, 'Uh, yeah, I think so?', Navi (a glowing fairy) circling
the owl on the branch, one wing raised like a teacher, eyes closed in a kindly smile: 'Great, here's some wisdom!'
close-up: Link, doubtful and sceptical: 'Ok?', Navi bouncing off his cap
'Press R1 for an EXECUTION MOVE': a masked soldier with a rifle in the forest; the owl has swooped in behind him, wings closing round his head and neck for a neck-snap; an R1 button prompt
close-up: Link, hands to his cheeks, 'Oh my god!'
a Far Cry-style enemy camp: the gate blown in; a lookout fires from inside his wooden box up a watchtower; the owl (red bandana, machine gun) storms in
the camp: a soldier runs in from lower left and fires at the owl; the owl fires back with his machine gun; Link scuttles in behind through the gate, aghast
'R2 FOR GRENADES': Navi, glowing red, zips into a soldier kneeling behind sandbags as she explodes on him; an R2 prompt
close-up: Link, flat horror, 'This is horrible.', dirt falling past
Castle Town square: 'FIVE ROMANCE OPTIONS': a line-up of five (Zelda, Malon with a milk bottle, Ruto, a Goron, Saria) with the owl presenting them bottom left; a flower box in the near foreground
reverse shot down a Castle Town street (balustrades, drapes, banners, planters, townsfolk): Link close-up, deadpan, 'I am 9 years old.'
at a stone wall: the owl grabs Link by the collar with his wings, lifts him and slams him against the wall, furious: 'Now listen here, you s***...'
the same wall, a second angle: the owl holds Link up against the wall, shaking him: 'And you've got some god-damn CHOICES to make'; Navi reddening behind
close-up: Link pinned to the wall, terrified, tears: 'I want to go home.'; the owl's wings on his collar from the bottom corners; Navi reddening
